---
title: "NCSS series min_n=5 nested CV"
format: html
---

```{r setup}
library(beepr)
library(here)
source(here("code", "modeling_functions_05_02_2026.R"))
source(here("code", "pedon_pack_functions_05_02_2026.R"))

dir.create(here("outputs", "reports_05_02"), showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
```

```{r config}
# ============================================================
# CONFIGURATION
# Run nested CV for series at min_n = 5 only.
# Inner_v = 3 because per-class N is small at this threshold.
# ============================================================

OUTER_V   <- 5
INNER_V   <- 3      # smaller because per-class N is small
GRID_SIZE <- 10     # smaller grid for same reason
SERIES_MIN_N <- 5

MODEL_VARIANTS <- tribble(
  ~engine, ~space,
  "rf",    "plain",
  "xgb",   "plain",
  "rf",    "umap_hdb",
  "xgb",   "umap_hdb"
)
```

```{r load-data}
# ============================================================
# LOAD DATA
# ============================================================
ncss_pack_files <- list.files(here("outputs"),
                              pattern = "^pedon_pack_150_.*\\.csv$",
                              full.names = TRUE)
ncss_pack_path <- ncss_pack_files[which.max(file.mtime(ncss_pack_files))]
cat("Loading:", ncss_pack_path, "\n")

pedon_pack_150 <- read.csv(ncss_pack_path) %>%
  mutate(peiid = as.character(peiid))

cat("Pedons loaded:", nrow(pedon_pack_150), "\n")
```

```{r prep-series-min5}
# ============================================================
# PREP SERIES DATA AT MIN_N = 5
# ============================================================
df_series_min5 <- pedon_pack_150 %>%
  select(-any_of(setdiff(TAXONOMY_DROP_COLS, "taxonname_clean"))) %>%
  prep_outcome("taxonname_clean", min_n = SERIES_MIN_N)

cat("\n--- Series at min_n =", SERIES_MIN_N, "---\n")
cat("n =", nrow(df_series_min5), "\n")
cat("classes =", nlevels(df_series_min5$taxonname_clean), "\n")
cat("class distribution:\n")
print(table(df_series_min5$taxonname_clean))
```

```{r nested-cv-series-min5}
# ============================================================
# NESTED CV: series at min_n = 5
# ============================================================

cat("\n========================================\n")
cat("NESTED CV: series @ min_n =", SERIES_MIN_N, "\n")
cat("Outer:", OUTER_V, "| Inner:", INNER_V, "| Grid:", GRID_SIZE, "\n")
cat("========================================\n")

nested_cv_results_min5 <- list()

for (i in seq_len(nrow(MODEL_VARIANTS))) {
  eng <- MODEL_VARIANTS$engine[i]
  sp  <- MODEL_VARIANTS$space[i]
  key <- paste("taxonname_clean_min5", eng, sp, sep = "_")

  cat("\n>>> Variant:", eng, sp, "...\n")
  t0 <- Sys.time()

  fold_metrics <- tryCatch(
    nested_cv_one_variant(
      df = df_series_min5,
      outcome = "taxonname_clean", engine = eng, space = sp,
      outer_v = OUTER_V, inner_v = INNER_V,
      grid_size = GRID_SIZE, seed = 400 + i
    ),
    error = function(e) {
      cat("    ERROR:", e$message, "\n")
      tibble(fold = NA, accuracy = NA_real_, kap = NA_real_,
             bal_accuracy = NA_real_, f_meas_macro = NA_real_,
             n_test = NA_integer_, engine = eng, space = sp,
             outcome = "taxonname_clean")
    }
  )

  dt <- round(as.numeric(difftime(Sys.time(), t0, units = "mins")), 1)
  cat("    done in", dt, "min\n")

  nested_cv_results_min5[[key]] <- fold_metrics
}

# Tag with min_n_label so it's distinguishable when combined with the original
nested_cv_long_min5 <- bind_rows(nested_cv_results_min5) %>%
  mutate(min_n_label = "min_n=5")

# ---- Summary: mean +/- SD across outer folds ----
nested_cv_summary_min5 <- nested_cv_long_min5 %>%
  filter(!is.na(fold)) %>%
  group_by(outcome, engine, space) %>%
  summarise(
    n_folds          = n(),
    accuracy_mean    = mean(accuracy,     na.rm = TRUE),
    accuracy_sd      = sd(accuracy,       na.rm = TRUE),
    kap_mean         = mean(kap,          na.rm = TRUE),
    kap_sd           = sd(kap,            na.rm = TRUE),
    bal_acc_mean     = mean(bal_accuracy, na.rm = TRUE),
    bal_acc_sd       = sd(bal_accuracy,   na.rm = TRUE),
    f_meas_mean      = mean(f_meas_macro, na.rm = TRUE),
    f_meas_sd        = sd(f_meas_macro,   na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(min_n_label = "min_n=5") %>%
  arrange(desc(kap_mean))

cat("\n========================================\n")
cat("NESTED CV SUMMARY: SERIES @ MIN_N = 5\n")
cat("========================================\n")
print(nested_cv_summary_min5, n = Inf)

# ---- Save ----
write.csv(nested_cv_long_min5,
          here("outputs", "reports_05_02", "nested_cv_long_ncss_min5_series.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(nested_cv_summary_min5,
          here("outputs", "reports_05_02", "nested_cv_summary_ncss_min5_series.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)

beep("wilhelm")
```

```{r combined-with-existing}
# ============================================================
# COMBINE WITH EXISTING NESTED CV RESULTS
# So you have one canonical file with both thresholds.
# ============================================================

existing_summary <- read.csv(
  here("outputs", "reports_05_02", "nested_cv_summary_ncss.csv")
) %>%
  mutate(min_n_label = if_else(outcome == "taxonname_clean",
                                "min_n=15", "primary"))

existing_long <- read.csv(
  here("outputs", "reports_05_02", "nested_cv_long_ncss.csv")
) %>%
  mutate(min_n_label = if_else(outcome == "taxonname_clean",
                                "min_n=15", "primary"))

combined_summary <- bind_rows(existing_summary, nested_cv_summary_min5)
combined_long    <- bind_rows(existing_long, nested_cv_long_min5)

write.csv(combined_summary,
          here("outputs", "reports_05_02", "nested_cv_summary_ncss_combined.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(combined_long,
          here("outputs", "reports_05_02", "nested_cv_long_ncss_combined.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)

cat("\nCombined results saved with min_n_label distinguishing the two series models.\n")
```

```{r updated-figures}
# ============================================================
# REGENERATE FIGURES USING MIN_N = 5 AS PRIMARY SERIES THRESHOLD
# ============================================================
library(ggplot2)

# Use min_n=5 for series, primary for everything else
plot_data <- combined_summary %>%
  filter(min_n_label %in% c("primary", "min_n=5"))

tax_order  <- c("taxorder", "taxsuborder", "taxgrtgroup",
                "taxsubgrp_mod1", "taxpartsize", "taxonname_clean")
tax_labels <- c("Order", "Suborder", "Great Group",
                "Subgroup", "Particle Size", "Series")
names(tax_labels) <- tax_order

plot_data <- plot_data %>%
  mutate(
    outcome = factor(outcome, levels = tax_order, labels = tax_labels[tax_order]),
    variant = paste(engine, space, sep = " / "),
    variant = recode(variant,
                     "rf / plain"     = "RF (plain)",
                     "xgb / plain"    = "XGB (plain)",
                     "rf / umap_hdb"  = "RF (UMAP+HDB)",
                     "xgb / umap_hdb" = "XGB (UMAP+HDB)")
  )

thesis_theme <- theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        legend.position = "top",
        strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey95", color = NA))

# --- Dot plot ---
fig_ncss <- ggplot(plot_data,
                   aes(x = outcome, y = kap_mean, color = engine, shape = space)) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = kap_mean - kap_sd, ymax = kap_mean + kap_sd),
                width = 0.25, position = position_dodge(width = 0.5)) +
  geom_point(size = 3.5, position = position_dodge(width = 0.5)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("rf" = "#2C7BB6", "xgb" = "#D7191C"),
                     labels = c("Random Forest", "XGBoost"),
                     name = "Engine") +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c("plain" = 16, "umap_hdb" = 17),
                     labels = c("Plain features", "UMAP + HDBSCAN"),
                     name = "Feature space") +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1)) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Cohen's Kappa (mean ± SD across outer folds)",
       title = "NCSS nested cross-validation: model variant comparison",
       subtitle = "Series shown at min_n = 5 (28 classes)") +
  thesis_theme +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1))

print(fig_ncss)
ggsave(here("outputs", "figures_05_02", "fig_ncss_model_compare_min5.png"),
       fig_ncss, width = 10, height = 6, dpi = 300)

# --- Heatmap ---
fig_ncss_heat <- ggplot(plot_data,
                        aes(x = outcome, y = variant, fill = kap_mean)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white") +
  geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.2f", kap_mean)), size = 3.5) +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "#FDAE61", high = "#1A9641",
                      limits = c(0.30, 0.90), name = "Kappa") +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL,
       title = "NCSS nested CV: model variants × taxonomic levels",
       subtitle = "Series shown at min_n = 5") +
  thesis_theme +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1))

print(fig_ncss_heat)
ggsave(here("outputs", "figures_05_02", "fig_ncss_heatmap_min5.png"),
       fig_ncss_heat, width = 10, height = 6, dpi = 300)
```
